verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a reasonable thing for a legal-paperwork SaaS to offer, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no assistant inside Clerky itself. The MCP server (clerky-docs-22, clerky-probe-5) only lets external assistants like Claude and ChatGPT reach Clerky tools, which belongs to a different story. Assigning tasks to co-founders is human collaboration, an adjacent feature that earns no credit here.
